Chapter 7057: Dead?

Chapter 7057: Dead?

Though spectators have prepared themselves mentally for such possibilities, watching two primordial immortals being slaughtered still left them in horror.

Primordial immortals stood atop the world, having spent epochs training and suffering. This was their ultimate and unreachable goal.

Less than a dozen celestial immortals were known in history. Therefore, the primordial stage was the peak in their mind.

Killing one was immensely difficult. For a primordial immortal to kill a peer, this required epochs for a clean erasure. However, Li Qiye had total control over the situation and prolonged their suffering on purpose. He erased all of them, karma included.

Primordial immortals stared at Li Qiye in fear, not wanting to follow the fallen duo’s footsteps.

Keep in mind that during his killing, he had faced the horde’s onslaught. They had tried their best and couldn’t injure him in the slightest.

“Kill him!” They became infuriated by their helplessness and Li Qiye’s contempt.

“Tribulation Eruption!” They roared and exploded. However, instead of their flesh and blood exploding, only tribulations from within erupted with a single goal in mind - killing Li Qiye.

They struck Li Qiye and seemingly flipped Heavenrealm over. Li Qiye was trapped in the storm of explosions.

“Is it enough this time?” Spectators shuddered upon seeing the destructive storm.

“Should be a serious injury, at the very least.” One immortal murmured.

“Boom!” The explosions suddenly shifted back to the submerged immortals.

“!” The shift forced them to use their defenses and weapons. Of course, this was to no avail.

The shift destroyed and reduced them back to lightning and flames, causing monstrous waves to form in the ocean. It took a long time for relative tranquility to return. Lightning arcs still pulsed on the surface while the dead cultivators were no longer around.
